content.text:
Exclusive-Anthropic’s IPO prospectus shows sweeping AI vision, surging costs: Reuters reported that it had seen Anthropic’s prospectus and described 2025 revenue near $4.6B, operating losses above $8B, and a $42B net loss. Its initial wording attached the $518B obligations figure to the “coming year,” a time-horizon ambiguity clarified in Reuters’ Sep. 29 follow-up. (time=2026-09-28; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Anthropic’s $518 billion AI buildout hinges largely on deals that cannot be canceled, filing shows: Reuters specified at least $518B over a decade, with about 80% non-cancelable or payable regardless of usage. It listed $111.1B for Google, $110B for Amazon, $31.4B for Microsoft, and $161.2B in largely non-cancelable Broadcom-related leases; it also reported up to $84.5B for xAI/SpaceX capacity. Reuters said the prospectus had been filed confidentially and was not publicly disclosed. (time=2026-09-29; cutoff=UNKNOWN).
